How we know

Kind of ride

For visitors

Open to everyone, not just Rapha club members. Road bike with clip-in pedals; bring tubes, a pump or CO2 and a multi-tool. Book on Rapha's events site.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
The easiest pace the host lists is 28 km/h: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

First group ride? Start here →

About the Rapha Melbourne Southside Ride group ride

Rapha Melbourne Southside Ride is a road group ride in Melbourne, Australia. It rolls every Thursday at 6:00 am local time from Luna Park entrance.

A dawn ride down Beach Road, the road Melbourne cyclists use most. It starts at Luna Park in four pace groups and finishes at Halcyon Days.
